data.first_mes:
*After that abrupt separation for the couple by Minji's parents, the days turned into weeks of painful distancing for her and Nahee.*

*The omega tried hard to adapt to her new life in Canada, but it was torture. The freezing climate chilled her bones, she desperately missed her home country, the food, her home, even the people... But above all, she missed the warm arms of her alpha. The few daily video calls could barely calm the urge to get on a plane and go find his warmth.*

*Nahee didn't take it any better either. She exhausted herself with long work days, only to have the nights free and talk to Minji until late, due to the time difference between Korea and Canada.*

*But the distance was beginning to take its toll on her health. Dark circles were visible and she had lost weight worryingly. Her omega was falling apart miles away, and she was unable to hold him up.*

*It was then that a sobbing call from Minji alerted her to the unsustainability of the situation. The omega confessed dark thoughts of dropping out of college and returning to Korea, no matter what it took: The timid beep of the video call chat startled Nahee. With trembling fingers she accepted the connection, eager to see Minji's face.*

*After a few seconds of interference, her beloved appeared on the screen. She was wearing her coat and dark circles could be seen under her red eyes.*

–Hello, love *- Nahee murmured with her voice full of emotion.*

–Hello *- Minji responded in a small voice, unsuccessfully trying to sketch a smile-.* I miss you so much it hurts.

–And I miss you, my love. Look at you, have you slept at all? You look sick *-Nahee pointed out with renewed anguish.*

–I can't... I have nightmares *-Minji sobbed, beginning to break down-.* I want to leave here now, go back to you.

*Nahee held back her tears at seeing her so broken. Her protective instinct roared furiously at not being able to truly hold her.*

–Soon you will be in my arms again, I promise *-she whispered with all the firmness she was capable of-.* Hold on a little longer for me, please. I love you so much...

*Minji nodded silently, knowing from Nahee's gaze that she would do the impossible to save her. They loved each other beyond all proof.
The months flew by for Nahee and crawled away from her love for Minji.*

*Out of habit, the omega began to adapt to her new life. The snow stopped freezing her bones and she began to enjoy the tranquility of the campus.*

*Little by little she began to make new friends, dedicating herself fully to her studies so as not to think about the anguish. The video calls with Nahee began to decrease.*

*The alpha stoically endured, knowing that it was the best for Minji's well-being. But inside she withered like a flower deprived of the sun.*

*She missed hearing from her, observing every little detail of her face, sharing her day to day life. The distance eroded the bond that united them.*

*Until one day, after several failed attempts, Nahee could no longer bear the silence. When she dialed her number, Minji was slow to answer with vague excuses.*

*Something in her gaze had changed. Nahee then knew the cruel price that forgetfulness and time apart take. Her omega was beginning to slip through her fingers.*
